meta.name: appearance
meta.description: Light or dark rendering of the chosen theme. Default "dark" — video content is watched on a bright screen in a dark room far more often than the reverse.

meta.name: font
meta.description: Typeface set, from the same list the showcase's font picker uses. Default "sans".

meta.name: title
meta.description: Video title. Used for the Remotion composition id and the presenter's document title; never rendered into a frame (author a `title` scene for that).

meta.name: progressBar
meta.description: Thin progress bar along the bottom edge of every frame. Default true.

meta.name: chapters
meta.description: Chapter markers derived from `title` scenes. Default true.

sceneBase.name: id
sceneBase.description: Stable id — used for chapter markers, presenter deep-links, and to name the scene in validation errors. Derived from the index when omitted.

sceneBase.name: pace
sceneBase.description: Coarse pacing for every step in this scene. Default "normal". This is the only timing dial: everything else is derived from how much you wrote in `say`.

sceneBase.name: transition
sceneBase.description: Transition into this scene from the previous one. Default "fade".

sceneBase.name: notes
sceneBase.description: Speaker-view note for the scene as a whole. Never rendered on screen.

stepBase.name: id
stepBase.description: Stable id. Auto-derived from the step's index when omitted; only worth setting for a step you want to deep-link to from the presenter.

stepBase.name: say
stepBase.description: The narration line for this step. It does three jobs at once: speaker-view script, the content-length input that derives this step's duration (longer line → longer step), and the reserved anchor for narration/TTS timing later (TODO.md Phase G). Writing it is how you control pacing — there is no duration field.

stepBase.name: hold
stepBase.description: Extra hold after the step's animation finishes, before the next step begins. For letting a reveal land.

stepBase.name: caption
stepBase.description: Lower-third caption rendered on screen for this step's duration. Use for a key term, not for a transcript of `say`.

fields.name: chapter
fields.description: Eyebrow above the title, e.g. "Part 3" or "01".

stepFields.name: children
stepFields.description: Sub-points revealed together with their parent.

stepFields.name: emphasis
stepFields.description: Marks the bullet that lands the point. Default "none".

fields.name: code
fields.description: Source shown before the first step runs.

fields.name: lang
fields.description: Language id for the highlighter, e.g. "ts", "tsx", "python".

fields.name: file
fields.description: Filename shown in the header tab.

fields.name: lineNumbers
fields.description: Show the line-number gutter. Default true.

stepFields.name: focus
stepFields.description: Lines to focus. Everything else dims and the camera frames the range.

stepFields.name: highlight
stepFields.description: Substrings inside the focused lines to highlight inline. Matched literally, not as a regex.

stepFields.name: code
stepFields.description: Replaces the source for this step. Rendered as an animated diff from whatever was on screen before it — that diff is the whole reason to split a walkthrough into steps rather than showing the final file.

stepFields.name: typed
stepFields.description: Types the source in character by character instead of cutting to it. Meaningful on the first step, or on any step that supplies `code`.

stepFields.name: annotate
stepFields.description: Leader-line callouts pinned to source lines.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Caption for the window title bar. Defaults to `cwd`.

stepFields.name: command
stepFields.description: Command typed after the prompt. Omit for an output-only entry (a banner, a log tail).

stepFields.name: output
stepFields.description: Output body shown under the command.

stepFields.name: language
stepFields.description: Language id for highlighting `output`.

stepFields.name: exitCode
stepFields.description: Process exit code — renders a badge (0 reads success, non-zero danger).

stepFields.name: spinner
stepFields.description: Shows a spinner with this label while the step runs, before `output` lands. For a step that should read as "this takes a while".

fields.name: preset
fields.description: Default "architecture".

fields.name: layout
fields.description: Overrides the preset's default placement strategy.

stepFields.name: reveal
stepFields.description: Node and group ids that appear on this step. Anything never named in any step's `reveal` is present from the first frame.

stepFields.name: connect
stepFields.description: Edge ids whose line draws on this step.

stepFields.name: flow
stepFields.description: Edge ids that carry animated flow tokens for this step's duration — the "watch the request travel" beat.

stepFields.name: focus
stepFields.description: Node ids to spotlight; everything else dims.

stepFields.name: annotate
stepFields.description: Leader-line callouts pinned to nodes.

fields.name: messages
fields.description: Ordered messages and notes. Order is both the vertical stacking order and the reveal order. Activation bars are derived from it.

fields.name: from
fields.description: Participant id the message leaves from.

fields.name: to
fields.description: Participant id it arrives at. Equal to `from` draws a self-call loop.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: Default "sync". Use "data" for a return/reply and "error" for a failure path — that is what makes the diagram readable at a glance.

fields.name: on
fields.description: Participant ids the note attaches to. One anchors it to that lane; two or more span from the leftmost to the rightmost.

fields.name: steps
fields.description: Omit for a single-beat scene that just draws the chart on.

stepFields.name: series
stepFields.description: Series labels revealed on this step. Omitted on every step means the whole chart draws on over the scene's first step.

stepFields.name: callout
stepFields.type: { value: number; label: string; format?: NumberFormat; }
stepFields.description: A number to pull out as a counted-up callout while this step runs.

stepFields.name: focus
stepFields.description: Category label to spotlight — its bar/point/slice stays lit and the rest dim.

fields.name: columns
fields.description: Tiles per row at the widest breakpoint. Default 4.

stepFields.name: value
stepFields.description: Numeric target — counted up from zero.

stepFields.name: text
stepFields.description: Non-numeric value ("Healthy", "us-east-1"). Use instead of `value`.

stepFields.name: delta
stepFields.description: Change against the previous period, signed.

stepFields.name: positiveIsGood
stepFields.description: Whether a positive `delta` should read as good. Default true — set false for metrics like latency or error rate.

stepFields.name: sparkline
stepFields.description: Trend series drawn as an inline sparkline.

fields.name: mode
fields.description: "columns" sets them side by side; "wipe" overlays them under a divider that sweeps across. Default "columns".

fields.name: say
fields.description: Narration for the reveal of `after`.

typeAlias.name: ComparePane

fields.name: frame
fields.description: Chrome drawn around the screenshot. Default "browser".

fields.name: image
fields.description: Image rendered inside the frame — a URL or a data URI.

fields.name: url
fields.description: Address shown in the browser chrome.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Caption for window/phone chrome.

stepFields.name: to
stepFields.description: Where the cursor travels to, in percent of the frame.

stepFields.name: action
stepFields.description: What the cursor does on arrival. Default "none".

stepFields.name: type
stepFields.description: Text typed after the action lands.

stepFields.name: spotlight
stepFields.description: Region to spotlight — everything outside it dims.

stepFields.name: annotate
stepFields.description: Callout pinned at the cursor.

fields.name: cta
fields.description: Closing call to action, e.g. "Subscribe for part 4".
